nicole-j-jones.text: Endorsed by the Los Angeles County Democratic Party (2026 general election).

source.title: Los Angeles County Democratic Party: November 3, 2026 General Election endorsements

nicole-j-jones.text: Platform includes monitoring accreditation and the ending of the agreement with El Camino Community College District, and advocating for local and state support so Compton College has the resources and funding its students need.

source.title: Nicole Jones for Trustee 2026: Platform/Priority Issues

nicole-j-jones.text: Wants successful implementation of the Compton Promise and Lynwood Promise, continued expansion of dual enrollment with local high schools, and financial-literacy programs to complement financial aid.

source.title: Nicole Jones for Trustee 2026: Platform/Priority Issues

nicole-j-jones.text: Says that as a trustee she has 'a demonstrated record of advocating and supporting services for homeless students, financial literacy and student engagement.'

source.title: Nicole Jones for Trustee 2026: Platform/Priority Issues

nicole-j-jones.text: Pledges to 'Ensure that Compton College funds are continually reviewed and spent effectively, efficiently and ethically' and to execute the Campus Master Plan on time.

source.title: Nicole Jones for Trustee 2026: Platform/Priority Issues

nicole-j-jones.text: In her 2026 appointment questionnaire, named collaboration with K-12 partners including Compton USD, LAUSD's King-Drew Magnet High and KIPP charter schools to promote college readiness and dual enrollment.

source.title: Compton CCD: Nicole J. Jones application packet and trustee vacancy questionnaire, Trustee Area 2 provisional appointment (2026)

nicole-j-jones.text: Wrote that a trustee must decide based on 'policy, fiscal responsibility, and long-term institutional health — not special interests or individual pressures,' and represent taxpayers who expect accountability as well as students and staff.

source.title: Compton CCD: Nicole J. Jones application packet and trustee vacancy questionnaire, Trustee Area 2 provisional appointment (2026)

adrian-d-cleveland.text: In her 2026 appointment application, cited 30+ years at Compton Unified as plant manager and union steward, bringing 'collaborative labor-management engagement'; pledged to govern 'through policy and strategic direction, not operational management.'

source.title: Compton CCD: Adrian Cleveland application packet and trustee vacancy questionnaire, Trustee Area 2 provisional appointment (2026-02-19)

adrian-d-cleveland.text: Named sustaining funding and fiscal stability, enrollment and completion, student support services, workforce alignment and 'addressing equity gaps' as the major issues facing California community colleges.

source.title: Compton CCD: Adrian Cleveland application packet and trustee vacancy questionnaire, Trustee Area 2 provisional appointment (2026-02-19)

adrian-d-cleveland.text: Says Trustee Area 2 faces 'economic disparity, housing instability, and workforce transitions'; wants the district to expand affordable pathways, wraparound supports, employer partnerships and career technical education aligned with transfer preparation.

source.title: Compton CCD: Adrian Cleveland application packet and trustee vacancy questionnaire, Trustee Area 2 provisional appointment (2026-02-19)

notes: Both candidates applied for the March 2026 provisional appointment, and their application questionnaires are posted by the district. Nicole J. Jones (appointed incumbent) also has a campaign platform page. Searches used: 10
